card.name: Accusations of cover-up or failure
card.fires_on: Small words (is, was, of, for, a) and adjectives inside sentences that accuse authorities of wrongdoing, corruption, or failing to act. The next word could plausibly be 'cover' (cover up).

modes.label: Government inaction
modes.description: Verb after a government or agency subject, in a complaint that it is not acting.
modes.example: our government<< is>> not taking steps to address this,

modes.label: Corruption or blame
modes.description: Linking word or adjective before alleged corruption, wrongdoing, or a charge.
modes.example: who had charged there was<< widespread>> corruption in the NYPD

modes.label: Scrutiny and trials
modes.description: The word 'for' after being tried or criticized, before the offense.
modes.example: were tried<< for>> manslaughter but acquitted.

card.writes: It pushes the word 'cover' (as in cover up) and suppresses words about feeling.
card.plain: It fires in text accusing officials of wrongdoing or neglect, where a cover-up might be mentioned next.
